items.label: Setup S-1
items.nl: For each sample size \(n\), a full-data law \(P_n^F\) on the primitive array \((S,X,D(0),D(1),Y(0),Y(1))\in\{0,1\}\times[0,1]\times\{0,1\}^2\times[0,1]^2\), together with a source assignment mechanism drawing a binary encouragement \(Z\) given \(X\) with propensity \(e\); the source observation is \((X,Z,D,Y)=(X,Z,D(Z),Y(D(Z)))\) with law \(P_{\mathrm S}\), the target observation is \(X\) with law \(P_{\mathrm T}\), and the data are \(n\) source records and \(n\) target records drawn from the product experiment \(P_{\mathrm S}^{\otimes n}\otimes P_{\mathrm T}^{\otimes n}\). Covariate densities \(f_{\mathrm S},f_{\mathrm T}\), arm means \(m_{Az}\), contrasts \(\Delta_A\), reduced forms \(T_A\), first stage \(\mu=T_D\), complier indicator \(C=\mathbf 1\{D(1)>D(0)\}\), and the target complier effect \(\theta\in\Theta=[-1,1]\) are functionals of this law.

items.label: Setup S-3
items.nl: The observable rough-score construction: marked densities \(q_z,r_{Az}\), the seven-coordinate vector \(F\) with coordinate labels \(\mathcal I\), channel map \(g\) and marks \(W_i\), the transport integrand \(\Phi_A\), the deterministic four-block split \(\mathcal B_b^G\) with sizes \(m_b\), dyadic cells \(I_{\ell,K}\) and resolutions \(K_0,K_2,K_3\), normalized marked histograms \(H_{i,K}^{(b)}\), clipped pilot \(\widehat F\), residuals \(R_{i,K}^{(b)}\), the cubic statistic \(\widehat T_A\), its mean-square constant \(C_{\mathrm{mse}}\), radius \(r_n\), inverted score set \(\mathcal A_n\), and interval \(I_n\).

items.label: Setup S-5
items.nl: Comparator objects: a supplied admissible geometry \(\mathcal G=(f_{\mathrm S}^0,f_{\mathrm T}^0,e^0)\), a fixed finite interval partition \(\Pi\), the fixed-geometry and finite-cell subclasses, the known-geometry score \(\widetilde T_A^{\mathcal G}\) with envelope \(B_{\mathcal G}\), radius \(\rho_n^{\mathcal G}\), constant \(C_{\mathrm{fix}}\), inverted set \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathcal G}\) and interval \(I_n^{\mathcal G}\), and the continuous-geometry witnesses \(P_{\sigma}^{\dagger}\), \(\sigma\in\{-1,1\}\), built from \(g_{\dagger}\) and amplitude \(\varepsilon_{\dagger}\).

items.label: Setup S-6
items.nl: The lower experiment: amplitude constant \(c_{\star}\), cell count \(K_{\mathrm L}=\lceil n^{4/3}\rceil\), height \(h_n=c_{\star}K_{\mathrm L}^{-1/8}\), the admissibility predicate \(\operatorname{Adm}_{n,a}(c_{\star})\iff 0<c_{\star},\ h_n\le3/16,\ h_n^2\le\bar a(1/4-h_n^2)\) with \(\bar a=\max\{a,n^{-1/3}\}\), on which alone the least-favorable laws are constructed, bump \(B(t)=\sin(2\pi t)\), sign vectors \(\lambda\in\{-1,1\}^{K_{\mathrm L}}\), continuum index \(\tau\in[-1,1]\), tiled perturbations \(u_{\lambda}\), \(v_{\lambda,\tau}=\tau u_{\lambda}\), baseline receipt probabilities \(r_z^{(a)}\) and cell laws \(R_z^{(a)}\), assignment masses \(e_z^{(\lambda)}\), components \(Q_{\lambda,\tau}\), center \(P_{\star}\), uniform mixture \(M_{\tau}\), separation \(J_n\), and chi-square constant \(C_{\mathrm{mix}}\).

items.label: Setup S-7
items.nl: Unequal-sample extension: source size \(N_{\mathrm S}\), target size \(N_{\mathrm T}\), the class \(\mathcal M^{\mathrm u}_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}\) of laws satisfying every law-level condition of \(\mathcal M_n\) but observed under \(P_{\mathrm S}^{\otimes N_{\mathrm S}}\otimes P_{\mathrm T}^{\otimes N_{\mathrm T}}\), its strength slice \(\mathcal M^{\mathrm u}_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}(a)\), measurable connected random intervals \(C_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}\subseteq\Theta\), the honest class \(\mathfrak H^{\mathrm u}_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}\), and the minimax length frontier \(R_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}(a)=\inf_{C\in\mathfrak H^{\mathrm u}}\sup_{P\in\mathcal M^{\mathrm u}(a)}\mathbb E_P[\lambda_{\Theta}(C)]\).

items.label: Definition P-1
items.nl: \(\mathcal M_n=\{P=(P_n^F,P_{\mathrm S},P_{\mathrm T}):P\text{ satisfies ass:source-iid, ass:target-iid, ass:sample-independence, ass:source-density-bounds, ass:target-density-bounds, ass:source-density-holder, ass:target-density-holder, ass:propensity-overlap, ass:propensity-holder, ass:arm-means-holder, ass:receipt-consistency, ass:outcome-consistency, ass:instrument-randomization, ass:exclusion, ass:monotonicity, ass:transport-complier-outcome, ass:transport-complier-share, and ass:positive-strength at index }n\}\).

items.label: Definition P-2
items.nl: \(\mathcal M_n^{\mathrm{fix}}(\mathcal G)=\{P\in\mathcal M_n:(f_{\mathrm S},f_{\mathrm T},e)=\mathcal G\text{ at index }n\}\).

items.label: Definition P-3
items.nl: Write the supplied triple as \(\mathcal G=(f_{\mathrm S}^0,f_{\mathrm T}^0,e^0)\). For \(A\in\{Y,D\}\) and every positive integer \(n\), set \[\widetilde T_A^{\mathcal G}=\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n\frac{f_{\mathrm T}^0(X_i)}{f_{\mathrm S}^0(X_i)}\left\{\frac{Z_iA_i}{e^0(X_i)}-\frac{(1-Z_i)A_i}{1-e^0(X_i)}\right\}.\] This statistic uses only the observed source sample and the supplied geometry.

items.label: Definition P-4
items.nl: Set \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathcal G}=\{v\in\Theta:|\widetilde T_Y^{\mathcal G}-v\widetilde T_D^{\mathcal G}|\le2\rho_n^{\mathcal G}\}\). Set \(I_n^{\mathcal G}=\mathcal A_n^{\mathcal G}\) when \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathcal G}\ne\varnothing\), and set \(I_n^{\mathcal G}=\{0\}\) when \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathcal G}=\varnothing\).

items.label: Definition P-5
items.nl: \(\mathcal M_n^{\mathrm{cell}}(\Pi)=\{P\in\mathcal M_n:f_{\mathrm S},f_{\mathrm T},e\text{ are constant on every cell of }\Pi\text{ at index }n\}\).

items.label: Definition P-6
items.nl: Set \(\varepsilon_{\dagger}=\frac14\min\{1-c_f,C_f-1,1/4,L-1\}\). For \(\sigma\in\{-1,1\}\), set \(f_{\mathrm S}(x)=1+\sigma\varepsilon_{\dagger}g_{\dagger}(x)\), \(f_{\mathrm T}(x)=1-\sigma\varepsilon_{\dagger}g_{\dagger}(x)\), and \(e(x)=1/2+\sigma\varepsilon_{\dagger}g_{\dagger}(x)\). Conditional on \(X\) in both populations, assign complier probability \(1/8\), always-taker probability \(7/16\), and never-taker probability \(7/16\); set \(D(0),D(1)\) to the corresponding principal-stratum receipts and set \(Y(0)=Y(1)=1/2\). In the source draw \(Z\) conditionally independently of the potential variables with propensity \(e(X)\), observe \(D=D(Z)\) and \(Y=Y(D)\), and generate the two independent samples with their stated covariate densities. As a convention for representing these two conditional population laws by one combined full-data witness law, set \(P_{\sigma}^{\dagger}(S=\mathrm{source})=P_{\sigma}^{\dagger}(S=\mathrm{target})=1/2\); this convention is not an assumption on the ambient model class.

items.label: Definition P-9
items.nl: For \(n\ge n_0\), use the exact blocks \(\mathcal B_b^G\), sizes \(m_b\), dyadic maps \(K_0(n),K_2(n),K_3(n)\), normalized marked histograms \(H_{i,K}^{(b)}\), clipped pilot \(\widehat F\), and residuals \(R_{i,K}^{(b)}\) defined in the symbol table. For \(x_{\ell,K}=(\ell-1/2)/K\), define the observable linear term \[\mathsf L_A=\sum_{i\in\mathcal I}\left\{m_1^{-1}\sum_{r\in\mathcal B_1^{g(i)}}W_{i,r}\,\partial_i\Phi_A(\widehat F(X_r^{g(i)}))-\int_0^1\partial_i\Phi_A(\widehat F(x))\widehat F_i(x)\,dx\right\},\] the observable quadratic term \[\mathsf Q_A=\frac{1}{2K_2}\sum_{i,j\in\mathcal I}\sum_{\ell=1}^{K_2}\partial_{ij}\Phi_A(\widehat F(x_{\ell,K_2}))R_{i,K_2}^{(1)}(x_{\ell,K_2})R_{j,K_2}^{(2)}(x_{\ell,K_2}),\] and the observable cubic term \[\mathsf C_A=\frac{1}{6K_3}\sum_{i,j,k\in\mathcal I}\sum_{\ell=1}^{K_3}\partial_{ijk}\Phi_A(\widehat F(x_{\ell,K_3}))R_{i,K_3}^{(1)}(x_{\ell,K_3})R_{j,K_3}^{(2)}(x_{\ell,K_3})R_{k,K_3}^{(3)}(x_{\ell,K_3}).\] Set \(\widehat T_A=\int_0^1\Phi_A(\widehat F(x))\,dx+\mathsf L_A+\mathsf Q_A+\mathsf C_A\). Every integral is an exact finite sum because \(K_0\) divides \(K_3\) and \(K_3\) divides \(K_2\). Repeated coordinate labels use different evaluation blocks. For \(n<n_0\), set \(\widehat T_A=0\) and let \(\mathrm{def:score\mbox{-}interval}\) return \(\Theta\).

items.label: Definition P-10
items.nl: Set \(I_n=\mathcal A_n\) when \(\mathcal A_n\ne\varnothing\), set \(I_n=\{0\}\) when \(\mathcal A_n=\varnothing\), and set \(I_n=\Theta\) under the finite-size fallback in \(\mathrm{def:cubic\mbox{-}estimator}\).

items.label: Definition P-11
items.nl: \(\mathfrak H_n=\{C_n:C_n\subseteq\Theta\text{ is a measurable connected interval and }\inf_{P\in\mathcal M_n}P(\theta\in C_n)\ge1-\alpha\}\).

items.label: Definition P-12
items.nl:
For every \(n\ge n_0\) and \(0<a\le 1/4\),
\[
\mathcal M_n(a)=\{P\in\mathcal M_n:a\le\mu(P)\le1/4\}.
\]

items.label: Definition P-13
items.nl:
For every \(n\ge n_0\) and \(0<a\le1/4\),
\[
L_n(a)=\inf_{C_n\in\mathfrak H_n}\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_n(a)}
\mathbb E_P[\lambda_{\Theta}(C_n)].
\]

items.label: Definition P-14
items.nl:
For \(n\ge n_0\), \(0<a\le 1/4\), \(\lambda\in\{-1,1\}^{K_{\mathrm L}}\), and \(\tau\in[-1,1]\), put
\[
 b=\bar a=\max\{a,n^{-1/3}\},
 \qquad
 h=h_n=c_{\star}K_{\mathrm L}^{-1/8},
 \qquad
 v_{\lambda,\tau}=\tau u_{\lambda}.
\]
Define the admissibility predicate by
\[
 \operatorname{Adm}_{n,a}(c_{\star})
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 0<c_{\star},\qquad h\le \frac{3}{16},\qquad
 h^2\le b\left(\frac14-h^2\right).
\]
The following construction is made only when \(\operatorname{Adm}_{n,a}(c_{\star})\) holds. Set \(f_{\mathrm S}=1\), \(f_{\mathrm T}=1+u_{\lambda}\), and
\[
 e_1^{(\lambda)}=\frac12+u_{\lambda},
 \qquad
 e_0^{(\lambda)}=\frac12-u_{\lambda}.
\]
For \(z,d,y\in\{0,1\}\), define the eight source joint cells conditional on \(X=x\) by
\[
 Q_{\lambda,\tau}(Z=z,D=d,Y=y\mid X=x)
 =e_z^{(\lambda)}(x)R_z^{(b)}(d,y)
   +\frac{v_{\lambda,\tau}(x)(2y-1)}4.
\]
No clipping is applied. The corresponding conditional cells given \((Z=z,X=x)\) are obtained by division by \(e_z^{(\lambda)}(x)\). Define the complier potential-outcome margins by
\[
 M_{1y}(x)=P(C=1,Y(1)=y\mid X=x)
 =\frac b2-
 \frac{(2y-1)u_{\lambda}(x)v_{\lambda,\tau}(x)}
 {2\{1/4-u_{\lambda}(x)^2\}},
\]
and
\[
 M_{0y}(x)=P(C=1,Y(0)=y\mid X=x)
 =\frac b2+
 \frac{(2y-1)u_{\lambda}(x)v_{\lambda,\tau}(x)}
 {2\{1/4-u_{\lambda}(x)^2\}}.
\]
Give always-takers the masses of the \(Z=0,D=1,Y=y\) conditional cells, indexed by their observed \(Y(1)=y\), and give never-takers the masses of the \(Z=1,D=0,Y=y\) conditional cells, indexed by their observed \(Y(0)=y\). Conditional on \((X=x,C=1)\), set
\[
 P(Y(d)=y\mid X=x,C=1)=\frac{M_{dy}(x)}b,
 \qquad d,y\in\{0,1\},
\]
and couple \(Y(0)\) and \(Y(1)\) independently under these two binary marginals. Set the unused \(Y(0)\) of always-takers and the unused \(Y(1)\) of never-takers equal to zero. Draw \(Z\) conditionally independently of \((D(0),D(1),Y(0),Y(1))\) given \(X\), with propensity \(e_1^{(\lambda)}\), and observe \(D=D(Z)\) and \(Y=Y(D)\). Use the same conditional primitive full-data law given \(X\) in source and target, and use independent source and target product samples of size \(n\). As a convention for representing this witness by one combined primitive law, set \(P(S=\mathrm{source})=P(S=\mathrm{target})=1/2\); this convention is not an assumption on the ambient model class. This defines \(Q_{\lambda,\tau}\).

Let \(M_{\tau}\) be the uniform mixture of the resulting equal-size observed source-target product experiments over \(\lambda\in\{-1,1\}^{K_{\mathrm L}}\). Let \(P_{\star}\) be the combined law obtained by setting \(u_{\lambda}=v_{\lambda,\tau}=0\) while retaining the baseline strength \(b\) and the same witness-representation convention \(P_{\star}(S=\mathrm{source})=P_{\star}(S=\mathrm{target})=1/2\), and write \(P_{\star}^{(n,n)}\) for its observed equal-size product experiment. The predicate \(\operatorname{Adm}_{n,a}(c_{\star})\) restricts only the parameters of this least-favorable construction and is not an added assumption on the statistical model class \(\mathcal M_n\).

items.label: Definition P-15
items.nl:
For positive integers \(N_{\mathrm S}\) and \(N_{\mathrm T}\), let \(\mathcal M^{\mathrm u}_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}\) be the class of full-data and one-record observed-law triples satisfying every law-level density, smoothness, overlap, causal, transport, and positive-strength condition used in \(\mathcal M_n\), but observed under the unequal product experiment
\[
P_{\mathrm S}^{\otimes N_{\mathrm S}}
\otimes P_{\mathrm T}^{\otimes N_{\mathrm T}};
\]
thus the source and target samples are independent, the source contains \(N_{\mathrm S}\) records \((X,Z,D,Y)\), and the target contains \(N_{\mathrm T}\) records \(X\). For \(0<a\le1/4\), define the strength slice
\[
\mathcal M^{\mathrm u}_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}(a)
=\left\{P\in\mathcal M^{\mathrm u}_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}:
a\le\mu(P)\le\frac14\right\}.
\]
Let \(C_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}\) range over measurable connected random intervals contained in \(\Theta\), based on this unequal product experiment, and put
\[
\mathfrak H^{\mathrm u}_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}
=\left\{C_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}:
\inf_{P\in\mathcal M^{\mathrm u}_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}}
P\!\left(\theta(P)\in C_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}\right)
\ge1-\alpha\right\}.
\]
The unequal-sample minimax length frontier is
\[
R_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}(a)
=\inf_{C_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}\in
\mathfrak H^{\mathrm u}_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}}
\ \sup_{P\in\mathcal M^{\mathrm u}_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}(a)}
\mathbb E_P\!\left[
\lambda_{\Theta}\!\left(C_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}\right)
\right].
\]
This infimum--supremum formula defines the minimax frontier but asserts no off-diagonal rate or attaining construction.

items.label: Definition P-16
items.nl: For the unequal-sample minimax length frontier \(R_{N_{\mathrm S},N_{\mathrm T}}(a)\) defined in \(\mathrm{def:unequal\mbox{-}sample\mbox{-}handle}\), what is its exact piecewise order when \(N_{\mathrm S}\) and \(N_{\mathrm T}\) may diverge at unrelated rates, and can one construct a single finite-sample honest interval together with a matching legal no-defiers IV lower family in every phase?

items.label: Assumption A-4
items.nl: \(c_f\le f_{\mathrm S}(x)\le C_f\) for every \(x\in\mathcal X\).

items.label: Assumption A-5
items.nl: \(c_f\le f_{\mathrm T}(x)\le C_f\) for every \(x\in\mathcal X\).

items.label: Assumption A-6
items.nl: \(f_{\mathrm S}\in\mathcal H^{\beta}([0,1],L)\), meaning separately that \(\lVert f_{\mathrm S}\rVert_{\infty}\le L\) and \([f_{\mathrm S}]_{\beta}\le L\).

items.label: Assumption A-7
items.nl: \(f_{\mathrm T}\in\mathcal H^{\beta}([0,1],L)\), meaning separately that \(\lVert f_{\mathrm T}\rVert_{\infty}\le L\) and \([f_{\mathrm T}]_{\beta}\le L\).

items.label: Assumption A-9
items.nl: \(e\in\mathcal H^{\beta}([0,1],L)\), meaning separately that \(\lVert e\rVert_{\infty}\le L\) and \([e]_{\beta}\le L\).

items.label: Assumption A-10
items.nl: \(m_{Az}\in\mathcal H^{\beta}([0,1],L)\) for every \(A\in\{Y,D\}\) and \(z\in\{0,1\}\), meaning separately that \(\lVert m_{Az}\rVert_{\infty}\le L\) and \([m_{Az}]_{\beta}\le L\) for each such arm mean.

items.label: Assumption A-11
items.nl: \(D=D(Z)\) almost surely in the source population.

items.label: Assumption A-12
items.nl: \(Y=Y(D)\) almost surely in the source population.

items.label: Assumption A-14
items.nl: For each \(z\in\{0,1\}\), the source potential outcome generated by setting encouragement to \(z\) is \(Y(D(z))\) almost surely under \(P_n^F\).

items.label: Assumption A-16
items.nl: \(\mathbb E_{P_n^F}[(Y(1)-Y(0))C\mid X=x,S=0]=\mathbb E_{P_n^F}[(Y(1)-Y(0))C\mid X=x,S=1]\) for \(P_{\mathrm T}\)-almost every \(x\).

items.label: Assumption A-17
items.nl: \(\mathbb E_{P_n^F}[C\mid X=x,S=0]=\mathbb E_{P_n^F}[C\mid X=x,S=1]\) for \(P_{\mathrm T}\)-almost every \(x\).

items.label: Lemma L-1
items.nl: For every \(P\in\mathcal M_n\), conditional instrument randomization and receipt consistency give \(m_{Dz}(x)=\mathbb E_{P_n^F}[D(z)\mid X=x,S=1]\). Outcome consistency and exclusion give \(m_{Yz}(x)=\mathbb E_{P_n^F}[Y(D(z))\mid X=x,S=1]\). Therefore \(\Delta_D(x)=\mathbb E_{P_n^F}[D(1)-D(0)\mid X=x,S=1]\) and \(\Delta_Y(x)=\mathbb E_{P_n^F}[(Y(1)-Y(0))\{D(1)-D(0)\}\mid X=x,S=1]\). Monotonicity implies \(D(1)-D(0)=C\), so the two model-specific pointwise transport restrictions yield \(\Delta_D(x)=\mathbb E_{P_n^F}[C\mid X=x,S=0]\) and \(\Delta_Y(x)=\mathbb E_{P_n^F}[(Y(1)-Y(0))C\mid X=x,S=0]\) for \(P_{\mathrm T}\)-almost every \(x\). Integrating against \(f_{\mathrm T}\) gives \(T_D=\mu=P_n^F(C=1\mid S=0)\) and \(T_Y=\mathbb E_{P_n^F}[(Y(1)-Y(0))C\mid S=0]\). Positive strength then gives the algebraic identification \(\theta=T_Y/T_D\in\Theta\).

items.label: Lemma L-2
items.nl: For \(A\in\{Y,D\}\), every coordinate of \(F\) is the mean density of an observable bounded marked measure from \((\mathcal S_n,\mathcal T_n)\), \(q_z\ge c_f/4\), and \(T_A=\int_0^1\Phi_A(F(x))\,dx\). All derivatives of \(\Phi_A\) through order four are bounded on the deterministic clipping rectangle by a computable function of \((c_f,C_f,L)\).

items.label: Lemma L-3
items.nl: There is an explicitly computable finite constant \(C_{\mathrm{mse}}=C_{\mathrm{mse}}(c_f,C_f,L)\) such that, for every \(n\ge n_0\), every \(P\in\mathcal M_n\), and \(A\in\{Y,D\}\), the exact statistic \(\widehat T_A\) in \(\mathrm{def:cubic\mbox{-}estimator}\), using \(\mathcal B_b^G\), \(m_b\), \(K_0(n)\), \(K_2(n)\), \(K_3(n)\), \(H_{i,K}^{(b)}\), and the displayed linear, quadratic, and cubic finite sums, obeys \(\mathbb E_P[(\widehat T_A-T_A)^2]\le C_{\mathrm{mse}}n^{-2/3}\). The proof must establish the clipped pilot eighth-moment bound, exact cancellation of every projection term with one within-cell residual, and conditional variance bounds \(C_{\mathrm{mse}}\{n^{-1}+K_2n^{-2}\}\) and \(C_{\mathrm{mse}}\{n^{-1}+K_3n^{-2}+K_3^2n^{-3}\}\) for those exact quadratic and cubic sums, respectively.

items.label: Lemma L-5
items.nl:
Let \(n\ge n_0\), \(0<a\le1/4\), and \(\bar a=\max\{a,n^{-1/3}\}\). For a sufficiently small \(c_{\star}=c_{\star}(\alpha,c_f,C_f,L)>0\), the corrected construction in \(\mathrm{def:legal\mbox{-}iv\mbox{-}mixture}\) has the following properties uniformly over \(\lambda\in\{-1,1\}^{K_{\mathrm L}}\) and \(\tau\in[-1,1]\). Every component \(Q_{\lambda,\tau}\) and the center \(P_{\star}\) belong to \(\mathcal M_n(a)\). The construction is a no-defiers IV law and satisfies
\[
\mathbb E[C\mid X=x,S=0]=\mathbb E[C\mid X=x,S=1]=\bar a
\]
and
\[
\mathbb E[(Y(1)-Y(0))C\mid X=x,S=0]
=\mathbb E[(Y(1)-Y(0))C\mid X=x,S=1]
=-\frac{u_{\lambda}(x)v_{\lambda,\tau}(x)}{1/4-u_{\lambda}(x)^2}.
\]
Moreover,
\[
\mu(Q_{\lambda,\tau})=\bar a,
\qquad
\theta(Q_{\lambda,\tau})=-\frac{\tau J_n}{\bar a},
\qquad
\mu(P_{\star})=\bar a,
\qquad
\theta(P_{\star})=0,
\]
and
\[
2^{3/4}c_{\star}^2n^{-1/3}
\le J_n\le4c_{\star}^2n^{-1/3}.
\]
Finally, with \(C_{\mathrm{mix}}=19321/1800\),
\[
1+\chi^2(M_{\tau},P_{\star}^{(n,n)})
\le\exp\{C_{\mathrm{mix}}c_{\star}^4\},
\qquad
\operatorname{TV}(M_{\tau},P_{\star}^{(n,n)})\le(1-\alpha)/2.
\]

items.label: Theorem T-1
items.nl:
The interval \(I_n\) belongs to \(\mathfrak H_n\) for every positive integer \(n\). There is a finite constant \(C_0=C_0(\alpha,c_f,C_f,L)\) such that, for every \(n\ge n_0\) and every \(P\in\mathcal M_n\),
\[
\mathbb E_P[\lambda_{\Theta}(I_n)]
\le C_0\min\{1,n^{-1/3}/\mu(P)\}.
\]
Consequently, for every \(n\ge n_0\) and \(0<a\le1/4\),
\[
L_n(a)\le C_0\min\{1,n^{-1/3}/a\}.
\]

items.label: Theorem T-2
items.nl:
There is a constant \(c_0=c_0(\alpha,c_f,C_f,L)>0\) such that, for every \(n\ge n_0\), every \(0<a\le1/4\), and every measurable confidence set \(C_n\subseteq\Theta\) satisfying
\[
\inf_{P\in\mathcal M_n}P(\theta\in C_n)\ge1-\alpha,
\]
one has
\[
\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_n(a)}
\mathbb E_P[\lambda_{\Theta}(C_n)]
\ge c_0\min\{1,n^{-1/3}/a\}.
\]
In particular,
\[
L_n(a)\ge c_0\min\{1,n^{-1/3}/a\}.
\]

items.label: Theorem T-3
items.nl:
There exist constants \(0<c_0<C_0<\infty\), depending only on \((\alpha,c_f,C_f,L)\), such that, for every \(n\ge n_0\) and every \(0<a\le1/4\),
\[
c_0\min\{1,n^{-1/3}/a\}
\le L_n(a)
\le C_0\min\{1,n^{-1/3}/a\}.
\]
The upper bound is attained by the single interval sequence \((I_n)\) from \(\mathrm{thm:honest\mbox{-}upper\mbox{-}full\mbox{-}elbow}\): it does not use \(a\), and for every \(n\ge n_0\) and every law \(P\in\mathcal M_n\),
\[
\mathbb E_P[\lambda_{\Theta}(I_n)]\le C_0\min\{1,n^{-1/3}/\mu(P)\}.
\]
Neither bound has a leading logarithmic factor.

items.nl: realized by outcome0, outcome1, SourceDensityBounds, Exclusion

items.label: f_{\mathrm T}
items.nl: realized by TransportLaw, TargetDensityBounds, TargetDensityHolder, targetDensity_nonneg_of_bounds, targetDensity_integral_eq_one

items.label: T_A
items.nl: realized by transportedForm, ArmMeansHolder, armContrast_mem_Icc, targetDensity_nonneg_of_bounds, targetDensity_integral_eq_one, transportedForm_mem_Icc

items.label: \mu
items.nl: realized by firstStage, ArmMeansHolder, PositiveStrength, targetDensity_nonneg_of_bounds, targetDensity_integral_eq_one, firstStage_le_one_of_model

items.label: R_z^{(a)}
items.nl: realized by receiptOutcomeCell, receiptBase_mem_Icc, receiptOutcomeCell_nonneg, receiptOutcomeCell_sum_eq_one
